antropometria.title: Anthropometry
antropometria.imcHint: BMI is calculated automatically: weight (kg) / height² (m). IRD threshold: ≥ 27 kg/m².

lipidos.title: Fasting triglycerides and glucose
lipidos.tygHint: Formula: TyG = Ln [ TG × G / 2 ]. IRD threshold: ≥ 8.3.

ptgo.title: Oral glucose tolerance test (1 h)
ptgo.referencia: IDF (2024): IFG ≥ 8.6 mmol/L (155 mg/dL); DM2 ≥ 11.6 mmol/L (209 mg/dL).

result.title: IRD Result
result.placeholder: Enter data to calculate the risk score.
result.ptgoSinValor: No OGTT-1h value entered. If IRD is ≥ 8, the test is recommended.
result.disclaimer: This calculator is a clinical decision support tool. Definitive diagnosis of dysglycemia or diabetes mellitus must be confirmed by a physician with standardized laboratory tests.
result.tesisRef: See the doctoral thesis by González Tabares (2026) and the IDF Position Statement (2024).

recomendacion.accionInmediata: Immediate action: The patient has high IRD risk (≥ 8 pts) and altered OGTT-1h (≥ 8.6 mmol/L). Referral to Endocrinology is recommended, diagnostic confirmation per ADA/IDF criteria, and lifestyle intervention.
recomendacion.intervencion: Intervention: High IRD risk (≥ 8 pts) with pre-diabetes on OGTT-1h (≥ 8.6 mmol/L). Initiate lifestyle intervention, close follow-up, and consider referral to Endocrinology.
recomendacion.accion: Action: High IRD risk (≥ 8 pts). Perform OGTT-1h to complete glycemic status evaluation. If OGTT-1h is unavailable, consider HbA1c or OGTT-2h.
recomendacion.vigilancia: Monitoring: Moderate risk. Maintain periodic checks, promote a healthy lifestyle, and reassess at the next health examination.
recomendacion.seguimiento: Routine follow-up: Low risk. Maintain healthy habits, weight control, physical activity, and reassess at the next health examination.

ptgoInterpretacion.diabetes: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (≥ 11.6 mmol/L). Repeat testing is recommended for confirmation.
ptgoInterpretacion.prediabetes: Intermediate hyperglycemia / pre-diabetes (≥ 8.6 mmol/L). Lifestyle intervention and follow-up.
ptgoInterpretacion.normoglucemia: Normal glucose (< 8.6 mmol/L). Maintain healthy habits and periodic monitoring.

footer.disclaimer: For educational purposes only. Does not replace medical judgment.
footer.nota: This calculator is a clinical decision support tool. Definitive diagnosis of dysglycemia or diabetes mellitus must be confirmed by a physician with standardized laboratory tests. See the doctoral thesis by Rubén González Tabares (2026) and the IDF Position Statement (2024).
